mentions.name: Taskplan
mentions.description: This tool lets users build structured plans, assign tasks to people or teams, and track progress on a real-time dashboard. It targets large-scale deployments and migrations where plans are scattered across internal docs, spreadsheets, and Slack threads, coordinating work across multiple teams.
mentions.problem: Plans for large-scale deployments and migrations are scattered across internal docs, spreadsheets, and Slack threads, making coordination of work across multiple teams messy.
mentions.audience: Teams and individuals handling large-scale deployments, migrations, and other ops-heavy projects where plans are scattered across docs, spreadsheets, and chat threads.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I'm building Taskplan (https://taskplan.run) - it's like Ansible, but for people. Build a plan, assign tasks to people or teams, and get a real-time dashboard to track progress as the work happens.

evidence.value: So I'm building Taskplan (https://taskplan.run) - it's like Ansible, but for people. Build a plan, assign tasks to people or teams, and get a real-time dashboard to track progress as the work happens.
